patch.sql:
select distinct
    o_orderkey as order_key,
    o_custkey as customer_key,
    o_orderstatus as order_status,
    o_totalprice as total_price,
    o_orderdate as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as priority,
    _loaded_at as loaded_at
from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}
patch.explanation: The upstream raw.orders table contains exact duplicate rows (same order_key and all other column values). The staging model previously selected rows verbatim, propagating duplicates and causing the unique_stg_orders_order_key check to fail (3000 duplicate rows). By using SELECT DISTINCT we remove these exact duplicate deliveries while preserving the original schema, column names, and data types. This resolves the uniqueness check without altering any other logic.
